# ctables/str

> String literal: a static length-prefixed byte array.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/str.pkg)

  The `data` section declares a struct with the length (a word) followed by
  the bytes and a terminating 0, the same layout as bintables. The value is
  its address.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
((W)&{D.s})
```

## Data (per use)

```nasm
static struct { W n; B b[{len} + 2]; } {D.s} = { {len}, { {bytes}, 0 } };
```
